rdfs:label: made
rdfs:comment: A thing the agent made — the inverse of `maker`.
notes: Use on an agent to point at things they made. The inverse `urn:solid:maker` goes the other direction (work → agent). Repeat to list multiple works. For richer attribution, state it on the work instead with `urn:solid:creator` (dcterms:creator) or `prov:wasAttributedTo` (both work → agent).

examples.title: Person and the document they made

history.note: Notes clarify creator/wasAttributedTo point work → agent; seeAlso uses urn:solid:maker; added notToBeConfusedWith maker.
